# Charleston Landscape (concept by Kerblabs)

> Landscape design and build company serving the Charleston area and the Lowcountry, with over 45 years of expertise. Facts from charlestonlandscape.com. This is a free concept, not their official site.

- Phone: (843) 296-7592
- Contact form: https://www.charlestonlandscape.com/contact-us/ (name, email, phone, location, start date, budget, message)
- Note: per their site, not currently accepting general lawn maintenance clients; custom projects only

## Services
- Landscape design and installation
- Hardscaping: pavers, concrete, brick, retaining walls, pool decks
- Outdoor structures: kitchens, pergolas, decks, firepits, screened porches, fences
- Outdoor features: water features, cable railing, lighting
- Turf and planting: hydroseeding, synthetic turf
- Gutters and downspouts
